analyzed_vuln.description: `get_vlmeta_from_trailer` parses attacker-controlled trailer fields using signed 32-bit arithmetic and performs an insufficient bounds check: `if (trailer_len < offset + 1 + 4 + content_len)`. With crafted large `offset`/`content_len`, the sum overflows signed int32, so the check passes incorrectly. It then calls `memcpy(content, content_marker + 5, (size_t)content_len)` where `content_len` is effectively invalid, leading to ASan `negative-size-param`/huge copy size.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In `decompress_frame_fuzzer`, arbitrary input is passed to `blosc2_schunk_from_buffer` -> `frame_to_schunk` -> `frame_get_vlmetalayers` -> `get_vlmeta_from_trailer`. A crafted frame trailer must include vlmeta entries with valid markers (`0xde`, `0xd2`, `0xc6`) and non-negative but large 32-bit `content_len` plus chosen `offset` such that `offset + 5 + content_len` overflows int32. This bypasses trailer boundary validation and reaches the unsafe memcpy size/path, triggering the crash.
